problem_statement: osDelayUntil() does not handle a deadline that is already in the past. When called with a time earlier than the current kernel tick count, the function computes an unsigned difference that wraps around to a very large value and sleeps for effectively forever, returning success (osOK). Per the CMSIS-RTOS2 specification, requesting a deadline in the past should instead return an error status (osErrorParameter) and return immediately without blocking. A correct implementation must also handle a deadline that crosses the 32-bit tick-count wrap-around correctly.
